userStories.title: platform_posts model and migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need platform blog posts stored in the database so publishing stops being a code deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `platform_posts` to prisma/schema.prisma: id (uuid), slug (@unique), title, excerpt, content, coverImage, coverImageAlt, authorName, authorRole, published (default false), publishedAt, seo Json?, createdAt, updatedAt

Author is DENORMALISED STRINGS (authorName/authorRole), never a users FK — `users` is tenant-scoped in lib/db.ts so an FK join breaks on the apex, and it avoids the Clerk-id-vs-users.id P2003 class that broke the lekkerweed blog in PR #226. learning_resources sets the same precedent by carrying no author relation
Indexes on [published, publishedAt] and [slug]
platform_posts is NOT added to tenantScopedModels in lib/db.ts — that Set is opt-in and adding it would break every apex query

Migration authored as prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_add_platform_posts/migration.sql — a TIMESTAMPED DIRECTORY. entrypoint.sh runs `prisma migrate deploy` on boot so this applies itself. A loose .sql at the top of prisma/migrations/ is silently ignored (that is why add_platform_leads.sql needed manual psql)
Never `prisma migrate dev` or `db push` — DATABASE_URL may be live
pnpm prisma validate and pnpm prisma generate both succeed
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract the Wire HTML sanitiser to lib/
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one sanitiser shared by the storefront Wire and the coming platform posts API, so the two cannot drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Move the sanitize-html config currently inlined as `cleanContent` in app/store/[slug]/the-wire/[postSlug]/page.tsx (around line 164) into lib/ as an exported function
The allowlists are copied EXACTLY — tags plus img/iframe/video, the attribute map, allowedIframeHostnames (youtube/vimeo only), and the allowedStyles regex map. Do not loosen anything
The Wire page imports it and behaves identically
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Prerequisite for US-004 so the write API sanitises with the same rules as the read path.

userStories.title: Platform posts write API
userStories.description: As a super-admin, I need endpoints to create, edit, publish and delete platform posts.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/GET at app/api/platform/posts/route.ts; GET/PATCH/DELETE at app/api/platform/posts/[id]/route.ts
Guarded with withSuperAdmin / withSuperAdminParams from lib/api-auth.ts (around line 150). Returns 403 to a tenant admin

DO NOT model these on app/api/platform/leads — it is the only existing /api/platform route and is deliberately UNAUTHENTICATED (its header says so, because a prospect has no account). Copying its shape would ship an unauthenticated write API for blog content
Zod validation on all input
content sanitised on write using the lib/ sanitiser from US-003

Slug validated against POST_SLUG_PATTERN and POST_SLUG_MAX_LENGTH from lib/seo/post-slug.ts. Enforce the REGEX server-side — the tenant routes only apply normalizePostSlug plus a max length, which is known debt, not the example to copy
Duplicate slug returns 409 with a usable message, not a raw Prisma error
Setting published:true stamps publishedAt once and does not overwrite it on later edits
Explicit row types on every query — the any-widened Prisma client throws TS7006 on implicit-any map callbacks
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: /blog index reads the database

acceptanceCriteria: app/blog/page.tsx queries platform_posts where published:true, newest publishedAt first
Card layout, spacing and styling unchanged from the current page

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' — at build time DATABASE_URL is a dummy and the mock client in lib/db.ts returns [], which would bake an empty blog into the static output (the same reason app/sitemap.ts sets it)

An empty blog and a broken database MUST NOT look the same: a successful zero-row query renders the empty state; a query that throws logs the error and returns a controlled failure, never a 200 with no posts
The inline samplePosts array is still present at this point — the index reads ONLY the database, so posts not yet migrated will not appear until US-010/US-011. That is expected mid-run
